notes_for_editor: Only two pages support this story: the firelookout.com page and the FFLA Montana list. Two web searches added nothing. The 1960s conversion is a decade, not a year, so no built event was written. Montana DNRC sits in the header position where other pages name the managing agency; the page does not state the agency's role, so it is recorded as named. Record status 'gone' matches the page and list. Stryker Peak (us-mt-stryker-peak, a tower marked gone, firelookout.com/mt/strykerpeak.html) is a separate site about 5 km away; do not merge them.
